propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key because _haystack excludes these identifiers from the searchable text
rebar show correctly resolves identifiers via the binding store, but rebar search with the same identifier returns empty results, creating user confusion
the binding store's Jira-key mapping lives outside the reduced state and is only accessed by _resolve_via_binding_store, leaving search_states unable to match on Jira keys
identifier queries must be case-insensitive so that REB-1654 and reb-1654 both match the same ticket, mirroring the behavior of rebar show
search_states must remain pure (no filesystem or binding-store access) while gaining the ability to match identifiers through enrichment at the caller level in _engine_support/reads.py
